Enter your API key or a relay address

Your Octopus Live relay — a free Cloudflare Worker or your own server, e.g. https://octopus-live-worker.you.workers.dev/?token=… The app then reads from it instead of Octopus, so it can refresh every 10 seconds and doesn\'t need your API key. See the GitHub page for setup.
Notifications are off for this app — enable them in Settings to see live usage.
Ongoing notification with live electricity demand

While the screen is off it updates every 5 minutes. Your API key is stored only on this phone and is sent only to Octopus Energy. Without a relay, Octopus limits how often its API can be called: keep the interval at 60 seconds or more, or 90 if the PC skin also calls Octopus directly.
Live electricity demand and today\'s usage
Warn me if the gas has been on for 1½ hours or more
Gas meters report every half-hour and readings reach Octopus about an hour late, so the warning comes roughly an hour after the 1½-hour mark. Useful for catching a boiler or hob left on.
Gas left on, high electricity use, Home Mini offline
So the notification, widget and gas warning keep working while the phone is locked or the app hasn\'t been opened for a while.
✗ Battery: optimised — Android may stop updates
✗ May be paused if unused for a few months
Samsung: also go to Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps, and add Octopus Live.
Turn off “Pause app activity if unused” (or “Remove permissions if app isn\'t used”) on the next screen.
Add your API key above to see costs, prices and history. It\'s only used for these slower look-ups — live readings can still come from your relay.

Daily summary of yesterday\'s use and cost
Costs, cheap-price alerts and the daily summary need your API key. Cheap-price alerts only matter on tariffs whose price changes during the day; 0p means \"only when it\'s free or you get paid\".
